note_on_format: Papers 2011-2014 used old format: 10 questions, answer any 5, each 10 marks. Papers 2015-2024 use new 3-section format: Section A (any 2 of 4, 10 marks each=20), Section B (any 4 of 5, 6 marks each=24), Section C (any 2 of 3, 3 marks each=6). Total marks: 50 in both formats.

format_change_note: IMPORTANT: From 2015 onward, the paper changed to a 3-section format. Section A has 4 questions (answer any 2, 10 marks each). Section B has 5 questions (answer any 4, 6 marks each). Section C has 3 short notes (answer any 2, 3 marks each). Earlier papers (2011-2014) had 10 questions, answer any 5, all 10 marks each.
key_insights: ANOVA (one-way) computation is virtually guaranteed every exam in Section A
Chi-square computation appears in every paper
Mann-Whitney U is a Section B fixture from 2015 onward
Parametric vs non-parametric is the single most conceptually repeated question
Normal curve properties appear every year - high value for conceptual understanding
Hypothesis testing appears in some form every year
Regression computation appears in approximately 2 out of every 3 papers
Two-way ANOVA / interactional effect is a reliable Section B question from 2015+
Spearman's rho appears as Section A computation in 2 of every 3 papers
Short notes are highly predictable: Type I/II errors, level of significance, degrees of freedom, kurtosis cycle regularly
